posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
I had a great time last night on Skype attempting to defeat Cosmic Omnitron with a couple other forum-goers.

 

I think it would be fun to arrange regular, Skype-based meetups, but I see two major challenges:

1) To have more than two people on a Skype call requires that someone pays for premium Skype.

2) If more than a handful show up, we'd need to organize in to multiple games.

 

Is there interest in this?

Thoughts on the best way to handle these challenges?

What would be the best times for the meetup?

I regularly play in RPGs over Skype (as in at least once a week) and they feature 4 or more people all using the free version.

SECOND EDIT: I really do recommend that people take a look at the Vassal module it's really very useful for online play.

I'll have to find a place to host the files I made to add in the other heroes (it's still not playable without owning a copy of the cards themselves).
